description: Find SEC-registered public companies by ticker or name (fuzzy). Returns CIK (the SEC id used by every other tool), name, tickers, exchange and a match score (100 = exact ticker). Source: SEC company_tickers_exchange.json (companies with a listed ticker).

query.description: Ticker or company name, e.g. 'MSFT', 'berkshire', 'Tesla Inc'

name: search_company
title: Search SEC registrants
